Definition: of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian:--Apelles.
BiblicalUsage: Apelles is greeted by name in Paul's letter to Rome, among the believers Paul calls approved in Christ. One verse is all we have, and it is enough to know he stood the test and Paul wanted Rome to know it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Apelles matters because faithfulness does not need a long story to be real. Approved in Christ is the whole verdict, and I hold that it is the verdict I want for myself.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
